tagline: — helps your money last as long as you
greeting: Hi. I'm RE — I want to help you make your money last as long as you in just a few questions. Nothing you say leaves this browser.
errorHint: Just a number is fine — try "{{example}}".
privacyNote: Nothing is sent anywhere — this all happens in your browser.

q.currentAge: First — how old are you right now?
q.retirementAge: When would you like to start drawing? (You're {{age}} now.)
q.savings: Roughly how much have you saved all together — RRSP, TFSA, investments, everything? A round number is fine.
q.spending: Once you start drawing, how much do you want to spend each year? What would a good year cost?
q.benefits: Last one. Will you get CPP and OAS — the government benefits? Most people do.

doneLead: That's everything I need. Here's your answer:
short: Your money runs out at {{age}} — {{years}} years short of {{maxAge}}.
holdsSub: On those numbers the plan holds — there's money left at {{maxAge}}.
shortSub: The dashboard lets you drag the levers and watch the answer change; the assistant can answer questions about the plan.
next1: The dashboard is the live plan — drag a fader and the answer updates.
next2: Edits save themselves. Top right: the profile icon is your plans; undo steps back through saved versions.
next3: The Assistant button answers questions about this plan, on every page.

foot.helpBody: Answer the five questions and the plan computes itself. In the dashboard every number is live — drag the dot or move a fader and the answer changes with it. Stuck? The assistant answers plain-language questions about your plan.
foot.aboutBody: RE:tired is an open-source Canadian retirement model — one household projection engine, the same numbers behind every screen, running entirely in your browser.
foot.notAdviceBody: RE:tired is an educational model, not financial, tax, or investment advice. Tax and benefit rules are Canadian approximations — talk to a professional before acting.
foot.privateBody: No servers, no accounts, no tracking. Everything you type stays in this browser tab.
